## Requirements (from the spec's In-scope Stage A)
1. Academic, Op-ed, Memo as seeded versioned `Protocol`s matching the §6.7 table verbatim —
   configuration over shared phases, never skill forks (REQ-GENRE-1/4).
2. Rubric swaps/additions: Op-ed +`timeliness`; Memo `originality→decision_readiness` +
   `scope_discipline` (contracts vocab, never free strings).
3. Venue bars + tables; every row `verified_at` (H4) or stale-with-`as_of` rendered; user-typed
   venues still work (REQ-GENRE-3).
4. Phase defaults + verdict vocabularies per protocol, as config on the shared manifests.
5. Memo confidentiality enforced structurally: `user_sources[]` per run,
   `verified_against_user_source` verdicts, `web_fetch_of_user_data: "forbidden"` into the per-run
   URL policy — hooks AND proxy deny; the sheet states the rule (REQ-WF-8, REQ-GENRE-6,
   REQ-OBJ-11, §16.4).
6. ICMJE-shaped Academic disclosure + Op-ed/Memo AI-use templates via `packages/ai-use`
   (REQ-GENRE-5 Academic half).
7. Safe-field editing: `venue`/`length_norms`/`phase_defaults`/`stage` only — outside-set edits
   refused server-side (REQ-GENRE-2).
8. Protocol change → next Review scope card "protocol changed since vN was reviewed" + blocks
   (REQ-SPEC-17 wiring, P1.20 marker).
9. Op-ed + Memo golden fixtures registered, per-protocol assertions; every fixture under every
   protocol (REQ-POS-6).
10. A new fixture protocol = registry row + rubric config + ≤1 ledger column; no schema change
    (REQ-GENRE-7).

## Acceptance criteria — evidence
- [x] **Four seeded versioned Protocols; a test walks every §6.7 column against the seed bodies** —
      `ACADEMIC_PROTOCOL`/`OP_ED_PROTOCOL`/`MEMO_PROTOCOL` literals + `PROTOCOL_SEEDS` in table
      order in `packages/protocols/src/protocols.ts`; `protocols.test.ts` per-column tests
      ("matches the table" per protocol), `seedProtocols` idempotent upsert; `packages/db` seed
      test asserts all four ids land (`seed.test.ts`) + `protocol-evals.test.ts` reads the seeded
      bodies back out of PGlite (venue_bar kinds `outlet-table`/`silent-read`).
- [x] **Every seeded venue row `verified_at` or stale-with-date; user-typed venues work** — H4 is
      incomplete → every new row carries `as_of`, none `verified_at`; `venueRowStale`/`venueRowAsOf`
      + `protocols.test.ts` staleness tests pin "never neither", and `seedProtocols` leaves
      `venue_table_verified_at` NULL while any row is stale. User-typed venue is first-class
      (`venue` is a settings safe field; the venue bar stays a prompt, not a closed list).
- [x] **Safe-field editing only `venue`/`length_norms`/`phase_defaults`/`stage`; outside-set edits
      refused server-side** — `settings-routes.ts` strict patch schema; `settings-routes.test.ts`
      asserts `{title:"hax"}`/unknown `protocolId`/bad vocab all 422, and
      `protocol_changed_at` stamps only on a real protocol change (not a re-write).
- [x] **Memo: `user_sources[]` per run; `verified_against_user_source` verdicts;
      `web_fetch_of_user_data:'forbidden'` → per-run URL policy; zero fetch-log rows carrying
      user-source content; sheet states the rule** — `normalizeUserSources` (≤8 sources, name +
      text/url, http(s) only) at run create; `userSources` off-memo → `422 user_sources_memo_only`;
      source hosts → `inputs.urlPolicy.userSourceDomains` + `fetchUserDataForbidden`; provisioning
      maps both into the proxy allowlist AND the hook URL policy (`user_source` deny, no forward,
      403 + `user_source_fetch` pause signal); the proxy n-gram guard diffs search queries against
      source text and fetch logs redact query content under the marker; sources mount read-only at
      `user_sources/NN-<slug>.md`, the prompt gets the name→path index only;
      `verified_against_user_source` is a claim-verdict enum value + the mount header instructs it;
      `run-sheet/src/view.ts` renders the confidentiality line; web sheet carries the user_sources
      field. `handler.test.ts` (28) + `url-policy.test.ts` (16+20) + `user-sources.test.ts` cover
      every layer.
- [x] **Protocol change → next Review scope card "Protocol changed since vN was reviewed." +
      blocks** — `projects.protocol_changed_at` (P1.20) → `run-routes.ts` freezes
      `inputs.scopeBlocking` for `workflow=review` (server-derived, cleared by the consuming
      Review); `view.ts` renders the exact card copy; `view.test.ts` asserts it.
- [x] **ICMJE-shaped Academic disclosure + Op-ed/Memo AI-use templates from run facts;
      append-only, never a gate** — `packages/ai-use/src/templates.ts` registers
      `academic→icmje` (Rhēma as editorial-review environment; no machine-originated
      results/data/method claims; author-responsibility line), `op-ed` (target venue, exclusivity,
      sourced-news-peg), `memo` (user sources checked only against supplied materials, no web
      fetch, recommendation+numbers are the author's); `index.ts` side-effect registers them;
      Essay/`general` fallback unchanged. `templates.test.ts` + `statement.test.ts`.
- [x] **Op-ed + Memo golden fixtures registered with per-protocol assertions** — NEW
      `packages/protocols/src/eval-fixtures.ts` (`GOLDEN_EVAL_FIXTURES`: the three benchmark
      projects + `golden-op-ed` + `golden-memo`; `evalMatrix` = fixture × seeded-protocol cross
      product, every fixture under every protocol) + `fixtures/_evals/golden-op-ed.md` /
      `golden-memo.md` (authored drafts) + `eval-fixtures.test.ts` asserting the pinned
      phase defaults / verdicts / venue cap / `forbidden` marker per golden pairing — plus the
      DB-side asserts in `apps/api/src/protocol-evals.test.ts` (seeded bodies, the WaPo cap label
      on the editor DTO end-to-end, the memo sheet marker, the non-memo `user_sources` 422).
- [x] **A fixture protocol = registry row + rubric config + ≤1 ledger column; no schema change** —
      `protocols.test.ts` "REQ-GENRE-7" test validates + seeds a fifth literal against the generic
      `(id, version, body)` table — zero migrations touched for the three new protocols.
- [x] **Stage B legs green or deferred with owners** — `D-P1.21-1` (H4 verified venue seeds) +
      `D-P1.21-2` (Stage B prod seeding + one bounded Memo run, operator-gated ≤$15).
